grades.quote: the MMU has a TLB in which it keeps track of recently used virtual-to-physical translations; repeated access to the same virtual page number doesn’t require access to the page table. Only when a new page number is accessed is the page table (of whatever kind) accessed.
grades.reason: Directly explains how accessing new pages can require page-table lookups rather than reusing cached translations.

grades.quote: The computer system needs to have enough RAM to hold the _working set_ —the active portions of all active processes. Otherwise, the performance will be intolerably slow, because of disk accesses made on a routine basis.
